content.comment_body: Can someone assist me? My [product_name] display only shows three menu options: Setup, Network, and Diagnostics. I'm unsure how to perform a factory reset. Any support would be appreciated. Thank you.
Try checking the IP settings or your Ethernet cable. You can also start 'cmd' and use the 'ping' command for the device IP.

A factory reset can only be done with [product_name] [version_no] FS04. For the [product_name] [article_no] Standard, this feature is not available. The limited menu appears when the device is set to operator mode. To access administrator mode, you'll need to enter the password. Attached is an extract from [document] detailing the procedure.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are unclear about whether a factory reset is possible on the [product_name] [article_no] module. The initial post expresses frustration over the limited menu and a perceived lack of factory reset options. Another user clarifies that factory reset is not offered for this hardware, and menu expansion requires switching to administrator mode, pointing out confusion about menu access and device capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy method to perform a factory reset directly from the device menu, with broader menu access. There is also an assumption that factory reset is a standard feature for this product.
